Chapter 6347: Should Build Something

Chapter 6347: Should Build Something

Despite looking ominous, the light’s power couldn’t be questioned - a result of accumulation throughout the eras.

Others sensed it stretching endlessly, capable of grinding down an invincible existence to nothingness given enough time.

Crimson Virtue and Solar Monarch shuddered upon seeing this - the foundation of the Chen independent from the rest of Desolate Frontier.

Most importantly, this foundation could be controlled by Tenth-gen Chen. The same couldn’t be said about Everlasting Jiang and the main foundation due to the latter’s incalculable power.

On the other hand, First-gen Chen and the successors created this foundation through the cycles. This allowed them to use it to the fullest extent, certainly an advantage and the reason why the other ancient ancestors couldn’t suppress the Chen.

Doing so meant risking a pyrrhic victory. Therefore, the Chen was allowed to act as an independent entity.

Now, the top masters could see Tenth-gen Chen risking it all by activating this unique foundation. However, Li Qiye didn’t bat an eye.

“Feel free to try if you wish for today to be the end of your clan.” Li Qiye spoke as if this malefic foundation was utterly trivial.

Everyone from the Chen froze as a result, feeling as if there was a decapitation raised higher above their neck. He didn’t seem like a supreme overlord or an immortal, just a mortal. Nevertheless, he had done some outrageous acts by just raising his hand.

None dared to breathe loudly since they didn’t doubt his threat.

“Pop.” The malefic foundation suddenly disappeared and Tenth-gen Chen didn’t speak again.

The members lowered their head, the proud emperors included due to the complete loss. Although none died, their sect paid a price heavier than losing the emperors.

They could no longer stay in their home if they wanted to cultivate. Therefore, the right path was to leave Desolate Frontier for greener pastures. This alone was a heavy blow.

After all, they were used to being respected and feared. They had access to enviable resources but now, all was gone. They clenched their fists, realizing they had nothing left.

Absolute Ancestor watched emotionlessly, already having expected this outcome. Crimson Virtue and the others sighed.

Of course, they didn’t sympathize with the Chen. It was just this downfall was so swift.

“Now time to build something.” Li Qiye raised his resplendent hand.

“Buzz.” Silence Peak and its territory had dao runes everywhere.

They came together to form a chapter, turning a new page for Silence Peak. Worldly energy and dao power erupted, no longer hidden like before.
